description: 地下鉄位置情報(福岡市地下鉄) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 福岡市. 福岡市営地下鉄の駅の位置情報等のデータです。. Coverage: 福岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 福岡市. Its tags are インフラ, 位置情報, 輸送. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
